resources.string: Telegram\'s own Passcode Lock locks the whole app with a PIN or password and can unlock with your fingerprint. The options below lock single chats on top of it.
Hide locked chats from the chat list
Hide message text in notifications from locked chats
Allow screen lock PIN or pattern instead of fingerprint

Lock a chat from its ⋮ menu. Locked chats, their profiles and the archive ask for your fingerprint (or face) before they open, and lock again when you leave the app. Hidden chats also leave search; long-press the app name at the top of the chat list to show them, long-press again to hide them. Stored only on this device.
No locked chats yet. Open a chat, tap ⋮ and choose Lock chat.
Tap a chat to remove its lock.
Remove the lock from this chat? It will open without your fingerprint and show in the chat list again.
Chat locked and hidden from the chat list
Hidden chats shown until you leave the app
Set up a fingerprint, face unlock or screen lock on this device first.
